### The one substantive material defect found and cured

The white-leg collapse was **half-landed**. `--glass-rim-top` came to 0.10/0.08 (dark ≤ light) while `--glass-edge-light` survived beside it as a *second* white ring at **0.18 light / 0.22 dark** — above A-5's 0.12 ceiling, and **brighter in dark than light**, i.e. the exact shipped dark-brighter doctrine §6 exists to invert. Live in paint at `src/components/dock/styles/overflow.css:165`. It greened every gate because the A-5 arm named one token instead of censusing the class. Cured by collapsing the name onto `--glass-material-rim` (the A-14 sanctioned pure-indirection shape), so there is now exactly **one** white ink declaration in the tree and the fenced dock consumer inherits it with no dock-file edit.

### TR-vs-spec divergences resolved spec-senior
- **Rim geometry.** TR #22 says "rim one static leg 0.10/0.08". Spec §6 additionally rules the full-perimeter form the non-survivor ("`rim.css:90`'s composed directional form survives"). Resolved spec-senior: the surviving 0.10/0.08 leg is the *key-driven directional* pair, and the full-perimeter ring collapses into it rather than being retuned to 0.10/0.08 as a parallel geometry.
- **Grasp radius.** TR pins `blur(26px)`; spec R-6 derives `host × 1.625`. Disk carries the derivation — spec-senior, left as landed.
- **Release clock.** TR says "release 180ms"; spec R-9 puts it on `--ease-standard` × `--spring-dock-duration`. Disk carries the register — spec-senior, left as landed.
- **§3.4 plate paint form.** Spec spells three tokens painted as `background-color` + `background-image`; disk collapses to one `color-mix(in srgb, oklch(from ink …) calc(level*100%), var(--card))`. I verified these are **algebraically identical** at level 0, 0.3 and 1 (composite α = 0.7+0.3·rung at level 0.3 in both forms), zero nested `color-mix()`, so `G-WK-COLORMIX-BUDGET` holds by construction. Left as landed — the spec's law ("one flat mix") is satisfied by the shorter form.

### Routed inbound — all three discharged
- **Dead ambient channel** (`--glass-ambient-hue/-strength`, ⊕¹⁶(3)): struck end-to-end, **0 hits** across `src`+`demo` incl. the 111-line histogram organ (§7, R-12).
- **`W-PAPER-GRAIN-REAL` (∥#22):** this wave owns only the `paper.css` `@supports (backdrop-filter: …)` engine-class proxy — struck, A-14 green. The 22:3 feTurbulence sweep stays #68's.
- **Stale menu-row prose flag:** already adjudicated the spec's way — the "menu-row (the quiet tier)" line is gone from `tokens/glass.css`, and `src/components/_shared/menu/menu.css:3-8` now records the ruling (a row is not a lens; it carries a hover fill reading `--glass-plate-quiet`, no row-level rung). Prose fixed, lens not bound. Verified, no edit needed.

The 1 expected fail is the sanctioned `stacked-url-filter` `it.fails`. **Caveat, stated honestly:** at the default 5000ms timeout this suite is flaky under machine contention — I got clean 144/144 runs and 1–6 file failures across seven runs, every failure a `Test timed out in 5000ms` on heavy fuzz/mount suites (aurora fuzz, dropdown portal, drawer detents, DataTable), with a *different* failing set each run and all passing in isolation. No failure touched a file I edited. `--testTimeout=60000` removes the artifact entirely.

### Could not land — with reasons

1. **Deep-tier reachability defect (found, diagnosed, NOT cured — routing recommended).** `--glass-blur-deep` is the only `--glass-blur-*` rung not declared at `:root`: it is declared solely on `.glass-deep` and `.dark`, and depends on `--glass-blur-deep-active-radius`, declared **only** on `.glass-deep` (deliberately — `glass-deep.css:68-83` explains that a `:root` composition would eager-substitute `--glass-depth` at its `@property` initial 1 and freeze the tier lerp). Two consumers read it **without** carrying `.glass-deep`:
   - `src/components/button/styles.css:43` — `.button[data-emphasis="primary"]`
   - `src/components/timeline/GlassTimeline.vue:197` — `.timeline-rail.is-deep`
   
   On both, the `var()` substitution fails and `backdrop-filter` is invalid-at-computed-value-time → computes to **`none`, in both light and dark**. This is precisely A-1's assertion and precisely §1's "structurally unreachable" disease — but it is **pre-existing at HEAD** (verified via `git show HEAD`), is named nowhere in the spec's rulings, edit plan or gate table, and the deep tier is held by §3.2/§3.3 as "a SEPARATE opt-in continuum … the shipped ceiling, unchanged". Curing it means giving every primary Button a 12.75–16px backdrop blur it has never had — an unmeasured repaint of the library's most-used component, at a seat whose π battery has not run. I declined to mint that repaint on a token wave and did not add a second `it.fails` (the gate allows exactly one). **Recommend routing to the deep tier's own row with a paired capture.** The clean fix shape is a `@utility glass-deep-optic` in `glass/deep.css` composed by all three consumers (the `glass-plate` idiom this wave established) — `@apply` is confirmed available in component CSS, though **not** demonstrated anywhere in a `.vue` `<style>` block, which is the open question for the timeline arm.
2. **π battery (§12) not run** — π-1/π-2/π-3/π-5 are capture cells needing a live browser seat and `/navigation/tabs` + `/forms/slider` mounting a structured backdrop (#56's hard precondition, §12). Per **CLOSING LAW F-2 the wave does not close on this seat**: `G-FROST-TRANSMISSION` is the closing gate and it is measured, not asserted. What I can attest is that F-1/F-3/F-4/F-6 are landed in source, so the battery's preconditions are met.
3. **Fenced files untouched, as directed (§8.3):** `track-well.css` (#86+#88 C-1 joint cut — #22 authors the law, bytes ride the joint cut), `SegmentedTabs.vue`/`segmented.css` (#32), `Slider.vue` (#35), `ModalOverlay.vue` (#89), `.cartoon-cast` (#87), `--glass-fill-tint` (#86 — zero bytes edited here), and dock/drawer files beyond §7's two lines (#7, ⊕²⁰(e)). Consequently the last two raw `saturate()` literals in the library (`dock/styles/shell.css:57` `saturate(1.2)`, `:195` `saturate(1.3) brightness(1.14)` — the ninth brightness lift) remain live and correctly belong to #7's consolidated round.
4. **Minor prose residue noted, not edited:** `src/styles/glass/surface-axis.css:96` cites "the canon note is in CLAUDE.md" — a file the owner deleted and which is never to be recreated. A dangling reference; §14 routes prose residue to #17/#61, so I left it rather than mint scope.
